# Padding

> Padding constructor.

<section class="intro">

</section>

<!-- /.intro -->

<!-- Package usage documentation. -->

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var Padding = require( '@stdlib/plot/vega/padding/ctor' );
```

#### Padding( \[options] )

Returns a padding instance.

```javascript
var padding = new Padding();
// returns <Padding>
```

The constructor accepts the following `options`:

-   **bottom**: bottom padding (in pixels). Default: `0`.
-   **left**: left padding (in pixels). Default: `0`.
-   **right**: right padding (in pixels). Default: `0`.
-   **top**: top padding (in pixels). Default: `0`.

```javascript
var padding = new Padding({
    'bottom': 10,
    'left': 20,
    'right': 30,
    'top': 40
});
// returns <Padding>

var v = padding.top;
// returns 40
```

* * *

### Writable Properties

<a name="prop-bottom"></a>

#### Padding.prototype.bottom

Bottom padding (in pixels). Default: `0`.

```javascript
var padding = new Padding();

// Set:
padding.bottom = 10;

// Get:
var v = padding.bottom;
// returns 10
```

<a name="prop-left"></a>

#### Padding.prototype.left

Left padding (in pixels). Default: `0`.

```javascript
var padding = new Padding();

// Set:
padding.left = 10;

// Get:
var v = padding.left;
// returns 10
```

<a name="prop-right"></a>

#### Padding.prototype.right

Right padding (in pixels). Default: `0`.

```javascript
var padding = new Padding();

// Set:
padding.right = 10;

// Get:
var v = padding.right;
// returns 10
```

<a name="prop-top"></a>

#### Padding.prototype.top

Top padding (in pixels). Default: `0`.

```javascript
var padding = new Padding();

// Set:
padding.top = 10;

// Get:
var v = padding.top;
// returns 10
```

* * *

### Read-only Properties

<a name="prop-properties"></a>

#### Padding.prototype.properties

List of enumerable properties.

```javascript
var padding = new Padding();

var v = padding.properties;
// returns [ 'bottom', 'left', 'right', 'top' ]
```

* * *

### Methods

<a name="method-to-json"></a>

#### Padding.prototype.toJSON()

Serializes a padding instance to a JSON object.

```javascript
var padding = new Padding({
    'top': 10
});

var v = padding.toJSON();
// returns { 'bottom': 0, 'left': 0, 'right': 0, 'top': 10 }
```

This method is implicitly invoked by `JSON.stringify`.

```javascript
var padding = new Padding({
    'top': 10
});

var str = JSON.stringify( padding );
// returns '{"bottom":0,"left":0,"right":0,"top":10}'
```

* * *

### Events

#### 'change'

Emitted whenever a property value changes.

```javascript
var padding = new Padding();

padding.on( 'change', onChange );

padding.top = 10;

function onChange( event ) {
    console.log( 'Updated property: %s', event.property );
}
```

</section>
